create_linear_module: create a Linear module with a specified output size and optional bias
build_linear_with_bias: build a Linear module that applies a matrix multiplication with bias to input tensors
test_linear_initialization: test the Linear module initializes weights using truncated normal with stddev 1/sqrt(input_size)
refactor_linear_no_bias: refactor the Linear module to compute matrix multiplication without bias when with_bias is False
review_linear_call: review the Linear module __call__ method that lazily initializes parameters on first invocation
